shadowRaw.$description: D-008 + braun-flat.md — RESERVED ONLY for layers that truly float above content: modal, popover, toast, dropdown. Never on card/button/input/badge in normal flow (those use border.hairline instead, see semantic/light.json + semantic/dark.json). Levels 0-2 intensity, kept light per D-008 ('ไม่ใช่เงาหนัก'). Colors are 8-digit hex (hex+alpha) so they stay plain DTCG color values without needing a separate alpha primitive. This is the LIGHT-theme shadow primitive; dark theme declares its own composite directly in semantic/dark.json since it needs different alpha/darkness to read against a dark canvas.
